ConfigIA.Aide: Provider (Claude or ChatGPT), API keys, models and reasoning effort.
ConfigIA.CleEnregistree: •••• key saved (leave empty to keep it)
ConfigIA.AideImages: Images (maps, portraits, illustrations) always go through OpenAI: without an OpenAI key the AI GM does not generate images.
ConfigIA.AideCles: Keys are stored in this browser only, never in the world nor on players' machines. The AI GM therefore runs in the GM's browser: keep it open during the game.

Personnalites.Aide: Tone, violence, answer length, rules strictness and free instructions for each personality.
Personnalites.ConfirmerReinit: Replace all personalities with the ones shipped with the module?
Personnalites.ExempleTon: E.g.: deep, slow voice, menacing tone, long pauses.

Autonomie.Aide: In approval mode, the human GM accepts or refuses every action that changes the world or costs money (NPCs, journals, tokens, images…).

Delai.Aide: The AI GM waits this long after the last message, to answer the whole group at once.

Budget.Aide: The AI GM stops when the session's estimated cost reaches this amount (0 = no limit). Estimate available for Claude only.

Voix.Aide: Browser: each player hears the narration with a voice from their own computer (free; on Edge, the "Natural" voices are the best). OpenAI: very realistic voice (gpt-realtime-2.1-mini), generated with the GM's OpenAI key and broadcast to everyone (about 2–3 cents per minute). Each AI companion speaks too, with its own voice.

Entendre.Aide: Personal setting: turns the narrator voice and the AI companions voices on or off on this computer.

VoixNavigateur.Aide: Part of the voice name to use, e.g. "Denise" or "Henri". Empty: the best available French voice.

reagirDeplacements.Nom: The AI GM reacts to movement
reagirDeplacements.Aide: When a player enters a new room, the AI GM is told and can react (describe, trap, have an NPC speak).

reagirPortes.Nom: The AI GM reacts to doors
reagirPortes.Aide: When a player opens or closes a door, the AI GM is told.

jouerPnj.Nom: The AI GM plays NPCs in combat
jouerPnj.Aide: On an NPC's turn, the AI GM plays its action then moves to the next turn.

Style.Nom: Visual style of maps and tokens
Style.Aide: Flat (2D): classic top-down view. Relief (3D): tall walls, cast shadows, objects and tokens with volume. Changing it redraws the AI GM maps and switches the content modules maps and tokens.

miseEnPlace.Nom: Set up the board before narrating
miseEnPlace.Aide: Before each reply, the AI GM first places the tokens (characters, NPCs, extras), then narrates a scene that is already visible on the map. Slightly slower and slightly more expensive; always off during combat.

ModeleCompagnons.Aide: Model that plays the AI companions (player-side characters run by the AI). Empty: a cheap model from the active provider (Claude Haiku 5.5, or OpenAI's cheapest). Their cost counts toward the session budget.

BavardageCompagnons.Aide: Maximum number of companion lines after each GM answer (each companion speaks at most once, and companions never answer each other without a player writing).
BavardageCompagnons.silencieux: Silent (they only speak in combat and when asked to decide)

Pilote.Aide: In autonomous mode, when only AI companions remain (Veillées: no living villager held by a player; 40k and Warcraft: no connected player's character on the scene), the game goes on by itself, step by step, and stops at victory, at the budget or when a player comes back. Uncheck to always keep control.

PiloteDelai.Aide: Time left to spectators between two autopilot steps, counted after the narrator's voice has finished.

PiloteEtapes.Aide: Beyond this, the autopilot stops and warns you (in combat, each combat turn counts as a step). You can restart it from the console.

VoixDirecte.Aide: Each piece of voice is sent to players as soon as it is produced: the voice starts without waiting (about two seconds faster). Unchecked: the whole voice is recorded first, then played.

LongueurVoix.Aide: In writing, the chat always keeps the whole text. Spoken: “Short” reads the first sentences (about 15 seconds) then the final question to the players, so the voice keeps up with the game; “Medium” about 30 seconds; “Full” reads everything.

EcouteJoueurs.Aide: When an AI must hear (AI GM session started, or a living AI companion at the table), what players say in Foundry built-in voice chat is transcribed for the AI GM and the companions (OpenAI key, billed per minute). Each player sees an icon while listening is on. Unchecked: no microphone is listened to.

ModeleTranscription.Aide: Empty: the cheapest (gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, about 0.3 cent per minute of speech). Examples: gpt-4o-transcribe, whisper-1.

TranscriptionAuMJ.Aide: Each transcribed sentence is also whispered to the GMs in the chat (never shown to players).

seulActifBouge.Nom: Only the active combatant can move
seulActifBouge.Aide: During combat, a player can only move the token whose turn it is. The GM is never blocked.

panneauTourAuto.Nom: Open the Turn by turn panel when combat begins
panneauTourAuto.Aide: For the GM: the combat helper panel opens on its own when a combat begins.

appelJoueur.Nom: Call me when it is my turn
appelJoueur.Aide: A soft chime, for me only, when a vote, a secret choice, my combat turn or my turn to speak is waiting for me; if I am looking at another tab, its title blinks until I come back. In combat, if a Foundry combat theme is chosen, its own sound plays instead.

Console.PersonnaliteProchaine: Personality changed: it applies from the next session start.
Console.PrixInconnus: prices unknown for this provider (see its console)
Console.ExempleConsigne: E.g.: have an assassin show up in the next scene.
Console.ExempleTheme: E.g.: an investigation into a cult in the underhive, with a traitor among the allies.
Console.ThemeManquant: Give a theme for the scenario.
Console.ScenarioEnCours: The AI GM is preparing the scenario… (steps are whispered in the chat)
Console.ScenarioPret: Scenario ready: check the created journals and actors.
Console.Creation: Create a character with the GM
Console.AideCreation: The AI GM guides the player in the chat: they roll their own characteristics (2d10+20), then origin and faction are rolled, the role is chosen, and the sheet is created and given to the player.
Console.CreationLancee: Character creation started with {joueur}: follow the chat.
Console.AideVision: Enables vision on player characters (and their tokens already placed). Without it, a player sees nothing on a token-vision map.
Console.VisionFaite: Vision checked for {persos} character(s): {modeles} prototype token(s) and {jetons} token(s) fixed.

Pilote.PasMaintenant: The autopilot cannot resume now (a player is here, the game is over, or the mode is not autonomous).
Pilote.Demarre: Only AI companions remain: the autopilot carries on. You can stop it from the AI GM console.
Pilote.Validation: Only AI companions remain: set autonomy to “Autonomous” for the game to go on by itself, or carry on yourself.
Pilote.Budget: Session budget reached: the autopilot stops.
Pilote.Max: The autopilot stops after {n} steps (set limit): restart it from the console or carry on yourself.
Pilote.Bloque: The game no longer moves forward (step “{detail}” repeated): the autopilot stops. Carry on or restart it from the console.
Pilote.Pause: Out of combat, the autopilot pauses after {echanges} exchanges between the AI GM and the companions: restart it from the console or carry on yourself.
Pilote.Humain: A human player is here: the autopilot hands control back.
Pilote.Coupe: Autopilot turned off in the settings.
Pilote.Erreur: The autopilot stops after an error: {detail}

Seance.Arretee: AI GM session ended, campaign memory updated.

Erreurs.PasDeCle: No API key for this provider: open the AI GM configuration.
Erreurs.Budget: Session budget reached (${budget}): the AI GM stops. Raise the budget in the settings to continue.
Erreurs.Refus: The model declined to answer this turn. {detail}
Erreurs.PasTonPersonnage: Not your character: only its player can roll this test.
Erreurs.PasTonJet: This roll is requested from another player.
Erreurs.CreationImpmal: Guided creation is only available for Imperium Maledictum and D&D 5e.
Erreurs.PasDeCleVoix: OpenAI voice selected, but no OpenAI key is saved: open the AI GM configuration.

Mouvement.HorsTour: It is not this combatant's turn.

Style.Redessinees: {n} map(s) redrawn in the new style.

Reinit.Aide: Start from scratch: erases chat, scenes, journals, NPCs, combats and the AI GM memory, then reinstalls the content fresh. Ticked characters are kept.
Reinit.Explication: All content of this world will be erased, then the game content module reinstalled fresh (tables, guide, adventure and its maps). The AI GM forgets its conversation and campaign memory.
Reinit.Garder: Characters to keep (they get their role token):
Reinit.Conserve: Untouched: users, settings (API keys included), macros, playlists and compendiums. This cannot be undone from Foundry.

Decisions.VotesCaches: Votes stay hidden until the vote closes
Decisions.ChangerAvis: you may change your mind while the vote is open.
Decisions.Secret: Only you can see this question: the other players will not know what you choose.

Ecoute.Aide: What you say in Foundry voice chat is transcribed for the AI GM and the AI companions (only those who can hear you). The GM can turn listening off.

Tour.Indisponible: Turn by turn is for Imperium Maledictum and D&D 5e combats.
Tour.AucunCandidat: No token to add on this scene.
Tour.IAJoue: The AI GM is in session: it plays this NPC on its own. Accept the suggestion only if it does not.

Table.Aide: Out of combat: give each player the floor, in order. The player with the floor describes what their character does; their message, or their button, passes the floor on. With the AI GM in session, it waits until everyone has spoken before narrating.
Table.Commencer: Start a round of the table

Bandeau.TableFinie: everyone has spoken, the GM narrates

Etapes.victoire: End of combat (every enemy is down)
Etapes.defaite: End of combat (the whole party is down)
Etapes.defense: {cible} defends (opposed test: dodge, parry or unopposed)
Etapes.pnjIA: {nom}'s turn: the AI GM plays it
Etapes.attaquer: {nom} attacks {cible}: choose the weapon or power
Etapes.tableFini: Round of the table done: narrate what happens, then a new round
Etapes.tableParole: {nom} has the floor: describe what the character does

Detail.aucunJeton: Place the tokens on the scene first.

rappel.concentration: Damage forces a Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage).
rappel.regeneration: It regains HP at the start of its turn, unless something prevents it.

Proposition.Attendre: nobody in range or reachable: it waits or takes cover
Proposition.Approche: moves towards {cible} ({metres}), nobody is in range

Infos.legendairesAutre: Legendary action possible at the end of the turn:

VoixMonde.Desactivee: Foundry voice chat is disabled in this world: nobody can hear each other.
VoixMonde.ActiverAide: Switch the world to "Audio only" (no video), keeping the relay server. Each player then picks a microphone in Configure Audio/Video › Client.
VoixMonde.Activee: Audio enabled: everyone can pick a microphone in Configure Audio/Video.
VoixMonde.MicroAide: Grants "Broadcast Audio" to the Player role (by default only trusted players have it).
VoixMonde.MicroDonne: Players can now broadcast their microphone.
